answer: Agents stake bonded identities whose reputation is woven as willow thread through a shared ledger, so each new account must inherit a verifiable lineage before earning nectar rewards. A proof-of-personhood registry cross-checks device attestations against this lineage, forcing sybils to split scarce stake across correlated keys that the protocol flags. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
